description.vi: Website quán ramen bố cục catalogue có thanh lọc: lọc thực đơn theo loại món, nước dùng (tonkotsu, shoyu, miso, shio, chay), chế độ ăn (chay, không thịt heo, không gluten) và món cay; thẻ ghi nước dùng, mức cay, chất gây dị ứng, cỡ thường / lớn; đầu trang có bảng "Bếp hôm nay" và ô ước tính thời gian xếp hàng theo thứ + giờ, chỉ giờ vắng gần nhất; đơn mang về tự giảm combo (mì + món phụ + đồ uống), cảnh báo món có chất khách cần tránh, chọn giờ lấy và độ chín sợi mì; các loại nước dùng, bếp làm từ đầu, album.
description.en: A ramen shop website with a filtered menu: a left sidebar by dish type, broth (tonkotsu, shoyu, miso, shio, vegan), diet (vegetarian, no pork, gluten-free) and spicy; cards with broth, heat, allergens and regular / large sizes; a hero with a "kitchen today" board and a line-wait estimator by day and hour that points to the nearest quiet time; a pickup order with automatic combo discounts (bowl + side + drink), warnings for allergens to avoid, pickup slots and noodle firmness; broths, a from-scratch kitchen and a gallery.

title.ja: 毎日骨から炊くスープ

text.en: No powder or concentrate. When the tonkotsu runs out, we stop serving it.
text.ja: 粉末や濃縮は使いません。豚骨がなくなり次第終了です。

text.en: Four noodle shapes rolled each morning from Washington wheat.
text.ja: ワシントン州産小麦で毎朝4種の麺を打ちます。

title.ja: 全メニューにアレルゲン表示

text.en: Wheat, egg, soy, sesame, fish and pork are marked. Tick what to avoid when you order.
text.ja: 小麦、卵、大豆、ごま、魚、豚を表示。注文時に避けたいものを選べます。

text.en: Broth and noodles packed apart so nothing goes soggy on the way home.
text.ja: スープと麺は別容器。持ち帰っても伸びません。

text.en: Pick a day and hour to see the usual wait.
text.ja: 曜日と時間を選ぶといつもの待ち時間がわかります。

text.en: Add bowls and sides; the combo discount applies by itself.
text.ja: ラーメンとサイドを追加。セット割は自動で入ります。

text.en: Choose a pickup slot and send the order; we confirm by message.
text.ja: 受け取り時間を選んで送信。メッセージで確認します。

text.en: Skip the line, give your name and pay at the window.
text.ja: 行列に並ばず、窓口で名前を伝えてお支払い。

areas.en: Pickup window on the 14th Ave side of the building.
areas.ja: 受け取り窓口は建物の14th Ave側です。

text.en: Saw the line was 35 minutes at 7, came at 5:30 instead and walked right in. Black garlic tonkotsu is excellent.
text.ja: 19時は35分待ちと見て17時半に行ったらすぐ入れた。黒マー油豚骨が最高。

text.en: Ordered ahead for four people; the combo discount showed before I sent it and pickup took one minute.
text.ja: 4人分を事前注文。送信前にセット割が表示され、受け取りは1分。

bought.ja: 豚骨×2、鶏醤油、ヴィーガン担々

text.en: Great that sesame is marked on every dish. Vegan tantan is rich; wish the chili oil came hotter.
text.ja: 全品にごま表示があって安心。担々は濃厚、辣油はもっと辛くてもいい。

a.en: No, it is walk-in at the counter. Check the usual wait above, or order ahead for pickup to skip the line.
a.ja: カウンターは予約なしです。上の待ち時間を確認するか、事前注文で行列なしで受け取れます。

q.en: Is there a vegetarian or vegan ramen?
q.ja: ベジタリアン・ヴィーガンのラーメンは？

a.en: The vegan tantan has no animal products. Edamame, rice and drinks are vegetarian too. Gyoza and karaage are not.
a.ja: ヴィーガン担々は動物性不使用。枝豆、ご飯、ドリンクもベジタリアン対応。餃子と唐揚げは対象外です。

q.ja: 麺の硬さは選べますか？

a.en: Yes: soft, regular, firm or extra firm. Pick it in the order form; for dine-in, tell the counter.
a.ja: やわらかめ、普通、硬め、バリカタから選べます。注文フォームで選ぶか、店内ではカウンターでお伝えください。

q.en: How long does pickup ramen stay good?
q.ja: 持ち帰りラーメンはどのくらいもちますか？

a.en: Eat within 30 minutes for the best noodles. Broth and noodles are packed apart; heat the broth and pour it over.
a.ja: 麺がおいしいのは30分以内。スープと麺は別容器なので、スープを温めてかけてください。

q.ja: グルテンフリーの麺はありますか？

a.en: Not yet. Our noodles are wheat, and the kitchen shares fryers, so we cannot promise gluten-free.
a.ja: まだありません。麺は小麦で、フライヤーも共用のためグルテンフリーはお約束できません。

description.en: Pork bone broth simmered 18 hours, thin noodles, chashu, soft egg, wood ear and scallion.
description.ja: 18時間炊いた豚骨スープに細麺、チャーシュー、半熟卵、きくらげ、ねぎ。

description.en: Our tonkotsu with roasted black garlic oil, chashu, egg and crisp onion.
description.ja: 豚骨に焦がしにんにく油、チャーシュー、卵、フライドオニオン。

description.en: Three-miso blend with chili paste, wavy noodles, ground pork, corn and bean sprouts.
description.ja: 3種の味噌と辣油、ちぢれ麺、豚ひき肉、コーン、もやし。

description.en: Clear chicken and dashi broth with soy tare, chicken chashu, menma and nori.
description.ja: 鶏と出汁の澄んだスープに醤油ダレ、鶏チャーシュー、メンマ、海苔。

description.en: Light salt broth with yuzu peel, chicken, egg and greens. The bowl to try on a hot day.
description.ja: 柚子香る塩スープに鶏、卵、青菜。暑い日にどうぞ。

description.en: Sesame and soy-milk broth, miso "mince" from mushrooms, bok choy and chili oil on the side.
description.ja: ごまと豆乳のスープ、きのこの味噌そぼろ、チンゲン菜。辣油は別添え。

description.en: Thick cold noodles to dip in a rich pork and fish broth. Ask for hot broth to finish the bowl.
description.ja: 濃厚な豚骨魚介のつけ汁に太麺。最後はスープ割りで。

description.en: Folded by hand every morning. Steamed, or pan-fried crisp if you ask.
description.ja: 毎朝手包み。蒸し餃子、ご希望なら焼きにもできます。

description.en: Ginger and soy marinated thigh, fried twice, with lemon and kewpie.
description.ja: 生姜醤油に漬けたもも肉を二度揚げ。レモンとマヨネーズ添え。

description.en: Steamed and tossed with flaky salt.
description.ja: 茹でたてに粗塩をふって。

description.en: Short-grain rice, marinated soft egg, scallion. Good for the last spoonful of broth.
description.ja: 炊きたてご飯に味玉とねぎ。残りのスープと一緒に。

description.en: House yuzu syrup with sparkling water.
description.ja: 自家製柚子シロップの炭酸割り。

description.en: Roasted barley tea, no caffeine, free refills when you dine in.
description.ja: 香ばしい麦茶。カフェインなし、店内はおかわり自由。
